sections.chapter_title: General purpose direct memory access controller (GPDMA)
sections.section_title: GPDMA channels with peripheral early termination
sections.text_helper: Section 19.3.5 "GPDMA channels with peripheral early termination" in chapter 19 (General purpose direct memory access controller (GPDMA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 937.
sections.section_content:
A GPDMA channel, if implemented with this feature, can support the early termination of
thedata transfer from the peripheral which does also support this feature.
[Table 100. GPDMA1 channel with peripheral early termination]
This GPDMA support is activated when the channel x is programmed with
GPDMA_CxTR2.PFREQ=1. Then, the peripheral itself can initiate and request a data
transfer completion, before the GPDMA has transferred the whole block
(seeSection19.4.14 for more details).
[Table 101. Programmed GPDMA1 request with peripheral early termination]
